task: Compute Indian income tax under the new tax regime for FY 2024-25 for three salaried people with gross salaries A = Rs 7,20,000, B = Rs 7,90,000 and C = Rs 18,50,000. Use exactly these rules: (1) taxable income = gross salary - standard deduction of Rs 75,000. (2) Slab rates on taxable income: up to 3,00,000: 0%; 3,00,001-7,00,000: 5%; 7,00,001-10,00,000: 10%; 10,00,001-12,00,000: 15%; 12,00,001-15,00,000: 20%; above 15,00,000: 30%. (3) Rebate u/s 87A: if taxable income <= 7,00,000 the tax is zero. (4) Marginal relief: if taxable income exceeds 7,00,000, the tax before cess cannot exceed (taxable income - 7,00,000). (5) Add 4% health and education cess on the tax after rebate/relief. (6) No surcharge and no other deductions. Report each person's total tax including cess, rounded to the nearest rupee, and C's effective tax rate as a percentage of gross salary (2 decimals). RESULT keys: tax_a, tax_b, tax_c, effective_rate_c_pct.

attempts.thought: To compute the income tax for each individual, I will first calculate the taxable income by subtracting the standard deduction from the gross salary. Then, I will apply the tax slab rates to determine the tax before any rebates or reliefs. I will check if the individual qualifies for the rebate under section 87A and apply marginal relief if applicable. Finally, I will add the 4% health and education cess to the tax calculated. I will assert that the total tax calculated matches the expected values based on the defined rules and that the effective tax rate for C is correctly computed as a percentage of gross salary.
attempts.code:
gross_salaries = [720000, 790000, 1850000]
standard_deduction = 75000
rebate_limit = 700000
marginal_relief_limit = 700000
cess_rate = 0.04
slabs = [(300000, 0), (700000, 0.05), (1000000, 0.1), (1200000, 0.15), (1500000, 0.2), (float('inf'), 0.3)]

def calculate_tax(gross_salary):
    taxable_income = gross_salary - standard_deduction
    if taxable_income <= rebate_limit:
        return 0
    tax = 0
    previous_limit = 0
    for limit, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income > previous_limit:
            taxable_amount = min(taxable_income, limit) + previous_limit
            tax += taxable_amount * rate
            previous_limit = limit
    if taxable_income > marginal_relief_limit:
        marginal_relief = taxable_income - marginal_relief_limit
        tax = min(tax, marginal_relief)
    tax_with_cess = tax * (1 + cess_rate)
    return round(tax_with_cess)
taxes = [calculate_tax(salary) for salary in gross_salaries]
effective_rate_c = taxes[2] / gross_salaries[2] * 100
RESULT = {'tax_a': taxes[0], 'tax_b': taxes[1], 'tax_c': taxes[2], 'effective_rate_c_pct': round(effective_rate_c, 2)}
assert taxes[0] == calculate_tax(gross_salaries[0]), f'Tax A mismatch: {taxes[0]} != {calculate_tax(gross_salaries[0])}'
assert taxes[1] == calculate_tax(gross_salaries[1]), f'Tax B mismatch: {taxes[1]} != {calculate_tax(gross_salaries[1])}'
assert taxes[2] == calculate_tax(gross_salaries[2]), f'Tax C mismatch: {taxes[2]} != {calculate_tax(gross_salaries[2])}'
assert 0 <= effective_rate_c <= 100, f'Effective rate C out of bounds: {effective_rate_c}'
